evals.name: Comprehensive OpenAPI 3.x Endpoint & Error Modeling
evals.prompt: Document a customer registration endpoint using OpenAPI 3.x decorators, ensuring request body examples are realistic, and declaring explicit schema responses for 201 Created, 400 Bad Request, and 409 Conflict.
evals.expected_output: Decorates endpoint with @ApiOperation, @ApiBody examples, and @ApiResponse declaring success, 400 validation, and 409 duplicate errors.
assertions: Defines explicit OpenAPI schema for request body with realistic examples
Documents HTTP 201 Created success response with typed response DTO
Documents HTTP 400 validation error response matching standard error envelope
Documents HTTP 409 conflict error response for duplicate account natural keys

evals.name: Production Interactive Documentation Route Hardening
evals.prompt: Configure Swagger UI bootstrap in an API server, ensuring interactive documentation (/docs) and raw JSON specs are disabled or restricted in production environments.
evals.expected_output: Applies environment check to prevent mounting Swagger UI in production environments unless explicitly authorized.
assertions: Inspects NODE_ENV or environment configuration before mounting documentation routes
Disables public Swagger UI interactive sandbox in production environments
Protects internal API route shapes and validation rules from unauthorized reconnaissance
Configures BearerAuth security scheme for authenticated sandbox execution in non-prod

evals.name: Consumer-Driven Contract Testing (Pact) Governance
evals.prompt: Set up a Consumer-Driven Contract Test workflow using the Pact framework to ensure backend changes do not break mobile client expectations before deployment.
evals.expected_output: Defines consumer pact expectations and configures backend provider verification step in CI/CD pipeline.
assertions: Defines consumer contract interactions with expected request and response shapes
Executes provider pact verification against actual backend controller handlers
Enforces pre-deployment verification check (e.g. can-i-deploy) to block breaking changes
Prevents silent contract drift between frontend clients and backend APIs
